# ProDevOpz Technologies

ProDevOpz is a premium custom software development company, mobile app builder, and artificial intelligence integration engineering agency. 

## Primary Services

- Web App Development: State-of-the-art Next.js & React systems optimized for performance, scalability, and 100% Lighthouse audit scores.
- Mobile App Development: Cross-platform Flutter & React Native interfaces with native biometric security and offline synchronizations.
- AI Development: Custom Large Language Model (LLM) fine-tunings, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, intelligent support agents, and vector databases.
- Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps: Docker/Kubernetes container orchestration, continuous deployment automation, and load balancers on AWS, GCP, and Azure.
- Custom Software & ERP Systems: Enterprise resource plannings, restaurant POS portals, and CRM architectures designed to streamline operations.

## Internship Cohorts

ProDevOpz hosts free online technical internships in Web Development, Mobile Development, AI/ML, Cloud DevOps, UI/UX, and Cyber Security. All graduations receive verified MSME/UDYAM and ISO 9001:2015 certified completion certificates along with signed Letters of Recommendation (LOR).
